text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer!
I'm borrowing Helios, 'kay! See ya later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios was deeply shaken
by the thought that she might not be able
to run alongside Daiichi Ruby—
choice_data_list: (But if we have our BFF bond...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Alright! First, time to flip the switch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's Pa!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Paah!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Where!? Where's the party!?
Where are they calling for me!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, over here~
P is for Palmer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahahahahaha!!
For real!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Even the name "Palmer-chin" sounds totally party animal!
It starts with "Pa" after all, right~!? Hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~!?
I never knew either until I met Helios!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then, allow me and my meta party
to escort you today♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Wahahaha, that was hilarious~!!
When did Palmer even pull that off...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You learned
a pose like that!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We were laughing so hard the pic didn't even turn out cute!
And we took it in a Purishi booth, too!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I thought really hard about it!
I knew it'd crack you up, Helios♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Delish!
What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I could drink a whole pitcher of this!
Since when was black tea this delicious!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Helios doesn't drink black tea often, right?
But if I'm going on a date with Ruby,
I figured tea is a must.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So I searched like crazy for high-end shop flavors
that Helios would totally love!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: For starters, in a British-style mug, makes it super easy to drink, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yep, super yummy.
Nom nom... num num.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
――Alright!
It's about that time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's wrap things up soon!
Of course, if it's us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All we can do is run!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Not in the moood. Just not feeling it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, never mind that!
Let's get going already!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wah!?
Aggro-mode Palm-chin!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san!
All right, let's run, Helios!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I knew it—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Palmer-chin?!
You really *are* the pushy delinquent type?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios reluctantly chased after Mejiro Palmer, who was being uncharacteristically pushy. However, once she started running—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come on!
If you're gonna mope around, I'm leaving without you!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That crazy runaway sprint is insane!!!!
I'm so hyped~~!! Wahaha, wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trai-piiii~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Did you see my bestie?!
Her runaway pace was legit insane, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So freakin' cool! I'm totally hyped!
Wait, this is crazy fun! Insane!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I sooooo love running!
Like, totally love it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
By the way, we did a lot of things today...
What was the most fun for you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Now! Right now! This!
Our race with Palmer-chin!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahaha.
Hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Is it broken?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! Total facts!
Races are definitely the way to go for Helios, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Racing is simply the best!!
Having fun is super—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Things like 'fun'...
are values unnecessary to me."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because these legs
are something everyone gave me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—That's not what I'm talkin' about!!
Ruby and Miracle are!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah crap, the buzzkill is setting in again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You see, both of them have something super precious
that they prioritize way above themselves.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I have no clue...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"All that matters to me is having fun!
Is that too frivolous!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Is it because I'm like this
that I can't make the young lady laugh?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know, Helios, your kind of fun
really saved me so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Truly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios is best just having fun. I know that for a fact.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I love the way Helios runs.
I absolutely love it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
By the way, me too!
Turns out there are things I'd prioritize over myself~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios.
You are my sun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When your bestie says it, you know it's true!
Helios is obviously the best!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chiiin!!
choice_data_list: We threw the best party ever with the best pal!
We threw the best party ever with the best pal!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
!
The ultimate pa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back to the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I mean, seriously!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we just throw
a massive party!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When you're bummed, partying turns it right around!
Let's invite Ruby and Miracle
to our party!
choice_data_list: ...Do you mean in terms of racing?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Thaaaat's iiiit—!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "That party earlier gave me a huge energy boost too!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"And y'know what, I've already thought of
the absolute best one."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —When we talk about having a party, it's gotta be the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, calling the grand year-end Grand Prix race, the Arima Kinen, a "party" is certainly fitting. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, you said before that the Arima was a no-go. Isn't long distance really too tough after all?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, I suppooose so~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, but I'll do it!
Yeah, I'm gonna do it!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Besides, winning when you can't even do long distances would be a total miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If they see that...
aren't both of 'em gonna get crazy hyped!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Trainey!?
...Good!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer, I should probably stop her from entering a race outside her aptitude. But—she's totally serious. If so, then...!
choice_data_list: Let's hype both of them up with your running!
Let's lift the two of us up with your running!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If it's come to that, I've got no choice but to go too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even if I win, it'll still be Helios's miracle.
After all, we're besties for life!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bestieee~~~~!!
choice_data_list: Let's go, to the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next target race
was hastily decided to be the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! If that's how it's gonna be,
I've got no choice but to go all out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go review my training routine!
See ya!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye~!
Thank you so much for today!!
choice_data_list: Palmer really is a great friend, huh.
Palmer really is a great friend, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right? ☆
As expected of my bestie for life!
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're true besties for life.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
It's not really a matter of true or false, is it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Besties are besties!
That's all there is to it, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
?
Okaaay☆
